title: Ergodicity of an Adaptive MCMC Sampler under a Probability Bound
summary: This paper provides sufficient conditions over the sequence of samples and parameters of an adaptive Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm to ensure ergodicity with respect to a target distribution that can have unbounded support. These conditions aim to make more easily usable the conditions of Containment and Diminishing Adaptation from Roberts and Rosenthal [2007] formulated over the transition kernels, without needing, as was done in other works, an artificial assumption of the compactness over both sample and parameter spaces.
